summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of the migration optimizer not reducing multiple consecutive AlterField operations correctly. It introduces a check to keep only the last AlterField operation if it represents the final state.

issues.description: The patch assumes that the last AlterField operation always represents the final state, which might not be true if there are other operations affecting the field in between. This could lead to incorrect optimization in more complex scenarios.
The new test file `reproduce.py` should be added to the test suite or integrated into an existing test file to ensure it runs as part of the automated tests.
